description: HAXS is the code-and-data reproducibility release for a predeclared fixed-time spin-squeezing-parameter contrast in a 3x3x3 stochastic moving-occupancy XXZ surrogate. The repository contains the simulation and analysis code, configurations, tests, dependency locks, deterministic figure builder, complete primary and frozen-confirmation source tables, exact-diagonalization/DTWA comparison, two-host reproducibility evidence, and publication-closure record. The reported contrast is bounded to the selected surrogate and does not establish a microscopic mobile-hole mechanism, component-level causality, finite-size scaling, universality, or an experimental prediction. This software release does not include the unpublished manuscript.
title: HAXS: stochastic moving-occupancy XXZ screening and reproducibility package
